Class StandardWebSocketSession

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.reactive.socket.adapter.AbstractWebSocketSession<jakarta.websocket.Session>
org.springframework.web.reactive.socket.adapter.AbstractListenerWebSocketSession<jakarta.websocket.Session>
org.springframework.web.reactive.socket.adapter.StandardWebSocketSession
All Implemented Interfaces:
Subscriber<Void>, WebSocketSession
Direct Known Subclasses:

public class StandardWebSocketSession extends AbstractListenerWebSocketSession<jakarta.websocket.Session>
Spring 用于标准 Java（JSR 356）`Session` 的 `WebSocketSession` 适配器。

5.0

  • Method Details

    • canSuspendReceiving

      protected boolean canSuspendReceiving()
      描述从类复制：AbstractListenerWebSocketSession
      Whether the underlying WebSocket API has flow control and can suspend and resume the receiving of messages.

      注意： 如果可能，建议子类以挂起模式启动，并等待收到需求。

      Specified by:
      `canSuspendReceiving` 类 `AbstractListenerWebSocketSession<jakarta.websocket.Session>`

    • suspendReceiving

      protected void suspendReceiving()
      描述从类复制：AbstractListenerWebSocketSession
      Suspend receiving until received message(s) are processed and more demand is generated by the downstream Subscriber.

      注意： 如果底层的 WebSocket API 不提供接收消息的流量控制，此方法应为一个空操作，且AbstractListenerWebSocketSession.canSuspendReceiving()应返回false。

      Specified by:
      `suspendReceiving` 在类 `AbstractListenerWebSocketSession<jakarta.websocket.Session>` 中

    • resumeReceiving

      protected void resumeReceiving()
      描述从类复制：AbstractListenerWebSocketSession
      Resume receiving new message(s) after demand is generated by the downstream Subscriber.

      注意： 如果底层的 WebSocket API 不提供接收消息的流量控制，此方法应为一个空操作，且AbstractListenerWebSocketSession.canSuspendReceiving()应返回false。

      Specified by:
      `resumeReceiving` 在类 `AbstractListenerWebSocketSession<jakarta.websocket.Session>` 中

    • sendMessage

      protected boolean sendMessage(WebSocketMessage message) throws IOException
      描述从类复制：AbstractListenerWebSocketSession
      Send the given WebSocket message.

      注意： 如果底层容器适用缓冲池，则在完全写入后，子类负责释放负载数据缓冲区。
